settings.title: DUALSENSE ADAPTIVE TRIGGERS SETTINGS
settings.desc: Adjust the physical force feedback intensity and advanced trigger physics for your PS5 controller. Changes are saved automatically.
settings.absStrengthHint: Controls the amplitude of the pulsation trigger effect when your front wheels slip under braking.
settings.tcStrengthHint: Controls the chatter vibration amplitude on the accelerator pedal when the rear wheels lose grip.
settings.resistanceHint: Scales the normal resistance weight of the triggers (weight of the accelerator and stiffness of the brakes).
settings.carDbHint: Downloads the latest database of car ID to car model mappings from GitHub to display names instead of IDs.
settings.absMinSpeedHint: Disables L2 ABS trigger rumble at low speeds to prevent vibrations while parking or starting.
settings.absFreqHint: The speed of L2 brake trigger pulsations when tires slip. Higher values feel like finer ABS vibration.
settings.revLimitHint: Vibrates the R2 accelerator trigger when engine hits the redline, warning you to shift gears.
settings.gearShiftHint: Delivers a physical pulse to the pedals when the car changes gears to simulate clutch/shifting kickback.
settings.r2ModeDesc: Select how the right trigger (R2) behaves under acceleration. Choose between plain realistic stiffness or various telemetry-driven physical feedback modes.
settings.r2LinearDesc: Simulates the weight of a real gas pedal. Constant linear resistance of the trigger (adjustable stiffness) without any dynamic vibration effects.
settings.r2FullDesc: Full set of effects: pedal resistance, wheelspin vibration (TC), and redline engine limit warning (Rev Limiter).
settings.r2TractionDesc: Pedal resistance and vibration only when the rear wheels lose grip on the road surface.

grip.title: GRIP MONITOR
grip.desc: Monitor grip and slip in real-time
